No-KYC Cryptocurrency Exchange Aggregator

KYC.RIP aggregates rates from over 10 non-custodial exchange providers to deliver the best swap prices for 700+ cryptocurrencies — without identity verification. Every trade is executed directly between you and the provider, with no intermediary custody of funds.

Privacy-preserving cryptocurrency exchanges have grown from niche tools to critical financial infrastructure. According to the Chainalysis 2024 Crypto Crime Report, non-custodial platforms account for a growing share of legitimate transaction volume as users seek alternatives to centralized exchanges with invasive KYC requirements.

The Stablecoin Graveyard on this page tracks over $4.7 billion in frozen stablecoin balances — assets seized without due process by centralized issuers like Tether and Circle. This demonstrates a fundamental vulnerability in custodial digital assets and underscores the value of truly private, censorship-resistant currencies like Monero (XMR).

Frequently Asked Questions

What is KYC.RIP?
KYC.RIP is a privacy-first cryptocurrency exchange aggregator that routes swaps across 10+ no-KYC providers to find the best rates. No accounts, no identity verification, no logs.
Is KYC.RIP safe to use?
KYC.RIP is non-custodial — we never hold your funds. Swaps are executed directly through licensed exchange providers. All connections are encrypted, and no personal data is collected or stored.
Which cryptocurrencies can I swap?
Over 700 cryptocurrencies across 50+ networks are supported, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Monero, USDT, and all major altcoins. New assets are added as providers expand their coverage.
How does the rate aggregation work?
When you request a swap, KYC.RIP queries multiple exchange providers simultaneously and presents the best available rate. This competitive routing typically saves users 0.5–2% compared to using a single provider.
What is Ghost Protocol?
Ghost Protocol is an advanced privacy feature that breaks on-chain fund links through automated routing techniques, providing an additional layer of transaction privacy beyond standard swaps.
Do I need to create an account?
No. KYC.RIP requires no registration, no email, and no identity verification. Simply select your currencies, enter a receiving address, and swap.

Non-Custodial Service

KYC.RIP is a purely non-custodial software interface. The developers do not hold, control, or have access to user funds at any time. Private keys are generated locally and never leave your browser.

No Warranty

OpSec Warning

While Stealth Mode utilizes burner wallets to minimize on-chain linkage, upstream providers (RPC nodes, Swap APIs) may retain ephemeral metadata. For maximum privacy, always use a VPN/Tor.

Third-Party Risks

Swaps are executed by third-party aggregators. We are not responsible for their service availability or liquidity issues.
